pages.text: Industrial Foregoing can support useful automation projects. Check the machine’s working area, power, fluids and output handling before leaving it to run.$(br2)Place machines where you can inspect the work. Use a small test area to understand a new device, then extend the setup when its behavior is clear.

Prepare Polyethylene Plates in your GregTech workshop for the plastic ingredients used by Industrial Foregoing. Make Simple, Advanced and Supreme Machine Frames in a GregTech Assembler. Later frames also need advanced materials and fluids, so follow the full chain in JEI.
